newsitem.title: UK: NWE mogas $2-3 a tpnne stronger, supply tightish.
newsitem.headline: NWE mogas $2-3 a tpnne stronger, supply tightish.

text.p: NWE gasoline was $2 or so stronger tonne firmer on Monday as the whole energy complex strengthened. Tight local supplies and strong prices in the U.S. continues to act as bullish support, dealers said.
Premium unleaded gasoline barges were around $186-187 fob ARA, about $2-3 tonnes higher than Friday's levels.
Dealers said physical trading was fairly muted in the morning, but a spate of deals may be forthcoming in the afternoon, especially after NYMEX opens.
